newsitem.title: UK: P&O says settles Florida port charges issue.
newsitem.headline: P&O says settles Florida port charges issue.

text.p: Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co said on Tuesday it had concluded all outstanding matters with the Florida Attorney General's office regarding an investigation into cruise industry port charges.
The company's subsidiary Princess Cruises has made a contribution of $85,000 to the cost of the investigation but has admitted no liability or wrongdoing, it said.

Peter Ratcliffe, president of Princess Cruises, welcomed the completion of discussions with the attorney general's office and said the company would be making the necessary amendments to its advertising practice by June 1.
The attorney general started an investigation 18 months ago into the way all cruise lines operating out of Florida advertised certain port and other charges.
P&O said the office had reached agreement with the nine major lines concerned.
